notes:
Intro: product analytics SaaS (B2B) — search + discovery for product docs and customer help content. Team: Head of Platform (Charlie Navarro), Eng manager for Search (Priya Desai), ML lead (Evan Park).

Quick summary: evaluating Redwood Hosted API first to prove embeddings + retrieval quality and measure unit economics, then a short Dedicated POC for predictable throughput and VPC peering. Mid-market buyer with moderate cost sensitivity but strong reliability/security requirements.

POC goals / acceptance criteria:
- Embedding quality: topical recall and semantic similarity > current TF-IDF baseline (qualitative eval sets: 120 queries).
- Throughput: sustained 150 qps for vector search at 95th percentile, burst to 400 qps tolerated.
- Batch jobs: ability to embed 2M documents in nightly windows (target < 6 hours) using bulk embeddings.
- Latency: ~<100ms retrieval for top-10 after vector DB lookup + re-rank (ideally <200ms end-to-end).
- Cost: target unit cost that keeps additional hosting ARR < $5k/month in initial year for hosted; Dedicated pricing investigated for predictable ops.

Architecture notes from call:
- Preferred vector DB: Pinecone (already trialing), willing to test Milvus for cost comparison. Need Redwood connector guide and sample pipeline.
- Data flows: batch ingestion (nightly), nearline incremental updates (every ~5-10 mins), query-time reranking with cross-encoder fallback.
- Security: SSO + SCIM required, SOC2 proof needed, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retention 1 year, data residency (US-EAST) strongly preferred.
- Network: For Dedicated they require VPC peering + private AWS links; firewall rules to be documented.

POC plan (proposed):
Phase 0 (this week): supply API keys, onboarding notebook, Pinecone connector example, cost estimator.
Phase 1 (2 weeks): Hosted API POC: run 1M document embeddings via bulk endpoint, index to Pinecone, run eval set and throughput tests at 50/150/300 qps. Deliver report (latency, cost per 1000 queries, top-k accuracy).
Phase 2 (2 weeks): If Phase 1 results OK -> Dedicated demo + trial: deploy reserved capacity, run the same benchmark under VPC peering, test autoscaling and canary fallback to hosted variants.
Phase 3: Contract negotiations (pricing tiers, SLA, support).
